name: expandrg
description: Talk to ExpandRG AI, powered by CREAO, understand your project, and monitor simulations in VS Code.

commands.title: ExpandRG: Set up (group, who I am, project)

expandrg.member.description: Who you are in ExpandRG (prototype sign-in), e.g. researcher_a.

expandrg.project.description: The ExpandRG project this folder belongs to. Set it with "ExpandRG: Choose project".

expandrg.connectorUrl.description: The local connector on this computer.

expandrg.connectorFolder.description: Only to run ExpandRG from a checkout of its source (the folder with run_demo.py). Leave empty to use ExpandRG installed in expandrg.pythonPath, which Set up installs.

expandrg.group.description: A research group made with `expandrg setup` (its ID). When set, ExpandRG starts that group instead of the demo.

expandrg.watchTerminalRuns.description: Watch runs started in the VS Code terminal: commands in the project's expandrg.json automatically, other runs (python, ./program, mpirun, ...) after you click Watch. Other commands are ignored and never read.

expandrg.pythonPath.description: The Python with ExpandRG installed (Set up installs it from this extension), e.g. a virtual environment's python.exe. ExpandRG starts in the background with it; reloading VS Code doesn't stop it.
